retrievalProfile.description: A dual-subject studio portrait featuring a seated male in a suit and a standing female in a voluminous white dress against a heavily textured, dark sepia-toned backdrop.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio composition featuring two figures. A man sits in a dark wooden chair in the foreground, wearing a dark blazer and light shirt, while a woman stands behind him to the right, lifting the hem of a large, tiered white lace dress. The background is a dark, painterly texture with visible brushstrokes and highlights. The overall color temperature is warm, dominated by deep browns, oranges, and stark whites.
coreVisualRelationships: diagonal tension between the seated man's leg and the woman's raised dress
stark contrast between the bright white dress and the dark textured background
vertical alignment of the display text with the seated subject's position
triangular composition formed by the heads of the subjects and the flare of the skirt
coreInvariants: high-key white clothing against low-key surroundings

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects occupy the central and lower-right two-thirds of the frame; the man is seated low-left, the woman stands mid-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, circular white skirt held aloft by the female subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold orange logo top-left, moves down to the seated man, then follows his leg across to the woman's face and the sweeping curve of her dress.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper-right and far-left corners, emphasizing the textured wall.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber and charcoal (background and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast; the orange provides the only high-chroma element.
paletteRestrictions: limited to earth tones, white, and a single accent color

letterConstructionRules: thick black outlines with a secondary white inner stroke
sharp, exaggerated descenders on specific characters
custom diacritics integrated into the letter shapes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'j' features a long, pointed tail that extends significantly below the baseline.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a heavy, vertically-distorted display face and a tiny, widely-spaced geometric sans-serif.

avoid: bright primary colors other than orange

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary heavy, condensed skeleton for the display text.
Clean geometric basis for the wide-tracked subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a Black man in a dark suit sitting in a wooden chair and a Black woman in a large white ruffled flamenco-style dress standing behind him, set against a dark, heavily textured brown and grey painterly wall. High contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, vertically stretched orange display title in the top-left with thick black and thin white outlines. Place a small, white, lowercase subtitle with extreme letter spacing at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the display text vertically elongated?
Does the orange text have a double outline?
Is the subtitle text lowercase and very widely spaced?
Is the background texture visible and painterly?

adjustableVariables: degree of vertical stretch on display font
postGenerationChecks: Check that the orange text is the most saturated element.
Ensure the woman's dress is the brightest white in the image.
Verify the wide tracking on the bottom text.
Confirm the background has a 'painted' or 'scuffed' texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + textured dark backdrop + high-contrast white clothing + vertically stretched outlined display type + wide-tracked geometric subtitle.
